what_it_is: Local-first LanceDB plus Tantivy retrieval backend and durable judgment-memory runtime for the Odylith Context Engine.
why_tracked: Gives Odylith's local retrieval and durable judgment memory an explicit governed boundary apart from sibling projection, remote-retrieval, and packet-contract components.
